_comment: Timing profiles for the LIVE cluster (docs/DEMO-PROFILE.md). Only the keys listed here are ever changed by scripts/demo-profile.sh. No quorum, trust-update rule, certificate, webhook or vote threshold is touched. 'default' repeats the shipped values so the script can switch back; tests/test_demo_profile.py checks they equal k8s/resilience/10-config.yaml.

default.description: The shipped timing: stages last at least 10 s, workload trust recovers 2 per second, Kubernetes' own 30 s pod shutdown wait.

presentation.description: Demo-friendly timing for the live cluster: the same stage dwell (3 s) and workload-trust recovery (8 per second) the simulator already uses for its results, and a 2 s pod shutdown wait instead of 30 s.
